name: RH56BFX
summary: RH56BFX is INSPIRE ROBOTS' five-finger anthropomorphic hand with six controlled degrees of freedom and 12 finger joints. The manufacturer emphasizes fast finger movement and specifies RS485 control, 24 V operation, 0.5 N force resolution and ±0.2 mm repeatability. The base left- and right-hand versions weigh 540 g. Separate wrist-equipped variants add two wrist degrees of freedom and increase the listed mass to 650 g. The official table distinguishes thumb force from the force of the other fingers, so these values should not be treated as whole-hand gripping force.
